purpose: Check whether valid SIP quotes exist in the first missing/ambiguous minute. Not a fill, label repair, return or strategy test.
selection: Fixed six-case missingness sample; cached BTCT already has quotes during the requested minute, so do not download it again. Fetch one minute for each remaining case, no pagination in this diagnostic. Every failure/cap retained.
valid_quote: Positive finite bid/ask and displayed sizes, bid<=ask. Size units are not converted or interpreted as executable capacity; historical event time is not receipt time.
outputs: Raw responses, provenance, counts, first/last valid quote time, spread range, capped/partial flags. No quotes means UNKNOWN not untradeable.
retry_policy: No retries in this probe; retain provider errors.
